concepts.way: boundary: word-for-word transliteration with no interpretation
concepts.quote: for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++); { System.out.printf("%d ", j); }
concepts.why: The answer only copies the inner loop back (with a stray semicolon that would even make the loop body empty), gives no output and no explanation of what printf prints, so there is no interpretation to level above L0.
